title: It failed in seconds
story: design.sh runs ProteinMPNN, but someone deleted a line from its #SBATCH header. Submit it, see why it fails, fix the script, and get a run that completes.

files.~/{{project}}/design.sh:
#!/bin/bash
#SBATCH --job-name=design
#SBATCH --partition=gpu
#SBATCH --time=02:00:00
#SBATCH --mem=16G
#SBATCH --output=slurm-%j.out

module load anaconda
conda activate proteinmpnn

python /opt/ProteinMPNN/protein_mpnn_run.py \
  --pdb_path inputs/target.pdb \
  --out_folder outputs/

tasks.text: Submit design.sh and let it fail
Fix the script and get a run that completes

hints: Read the slurm-NNNNN.out log. ProteinMPNN needs a GPU, and the header never asks for one.
`nano design.sh` and add the line `#SBATCH --gres=gpu:1` with the other #SBATCH lines, then `sbatch design.sh` again.

solution.text:
#!/bin/bash
#SBATCH --job-name=design
#SBATCH --partition=gpu
#SBATCH --gres=gpu:1
#SBATCH --time=02:00:00
#SBATCH --mem=16G
#SBATCH --output=slurm-%j.out

module load anaconda
conda activate proteinmpnn

python /opt/ProteinMPNN/protein_mpnn_run.py \
  --pdb_path inputs/target.pdb \
  --out_folder outputs/
